title: The orchestrator reads, waits and starts workers with one call each
goal: show prints an item's chosen fields or its version at a git ref as plain JSON; report prints a returned worker's outcome, commits and gates in one call; the worker brief carries the Conduct for changes section; a coord wait ends when a watched worker process has ended; next --batch prints the ready items that can run together; begin claims, pushes the claims and detaches the dispatch of items in one call

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Operator request 2026-10-24: plan telemetry and query-log derived items and stage them in todo state, focus on model work to deterministic tools, bash to deterministic, and the MCP server. This request promotes these sprint-orchestration items, parked since 2026-10-07 until EP-gzr4mmkm's fitness tests pass. Items stay draft while the sprint is planned and become todo at start. Order inside the sprint: brief and show first (they touch different files), then report, wait, next --batch, begin (each edits files the earlier ones edit). Sprint SP-f7kaebel waits on this sprint's last item for the files they share; SP-e3qyajjv waits on report. Evidence: the 2026-10-24 analysis, EP-sqt62vj2 and its notes.
